assembly_identity: 0x7a7c computes code-unit offset; tail jumps to PyCode_Addr2Line 0x7a98
0x7a98 initializes co_linetable, firstlineno and address-range stack fields
0x7b52-0x7b63 copies ar_end to ar_start and advances ar_end by (byte&7+1)*2
0x7b66-0x7b76 increments lo_next and skips continuation bytes until high-bit marker or limit
0x7b78-0x7b7a compares ar_end to requested instruction offset and repeats
native_samples_supplied_by_root.Root_sample_scope: Existing read-only diagnostic consumed only; this author did not attach/sample the process.

source_chain.fact: frame_getlineno calls PyFrame_GetLineNumber; cached nonzero f_lineno bypasses lookup, otherwise InterpreterFrame_GetLine.
LASTI times code-unit size feeds PyCode_Addr2Line.
Every ordinary Addr2Line lookup initializes a fresh range from the start of the co_linetable.
CheckLineNumber traverses forward until ar_end > lasti, then backwards only if needed.
advance increases bytecode address by at least two, increments lo_next, checks limit, and skips continuation bytes.
co_lines iterator merges consecutive same-line ranges; a small co_lines count does not imply a short raw table.
Trace LINE temporarily assigns f_lineno then resets zero; a generic cache cannot assume arbitrary tracing/setter behavior is absent.

runner_SOURCE_only_compilation.profile_scope: On every project-function call, including non-targeted calls, _origin095 walks runner ancestors and computes f_lineno up to three times per matching ancestor. It keeps overwriting origin until matching <module> then breaks.

conclusion.proven: The two actual native RIP samples are inside CPython line-table traversal. The external profiler repeatedly requests an expensive runner-module line lookup. This is a source-supported instrumentation overhead candidate.
not_proven: All wall time attributable to this hotspot
Qt callback corruption or product failure
Actual cache speedup or UI PASS
Windows code bytes/table counts equal Linux SOURCE compilation
conclusion.finite_valid_table_reason: For a valid table and in-range lasti, ar_end monotonically advances by at least two, lo_next advances toward a finite limit. Native sampling inside the loop alone cannot establish a stuck single invocation.

minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.cache_key: (id(cursor.f_code), cursor.f_lasti), two integers; do not hash the potentially huge code object.
minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.cache_value: (code, original native cursor.f_lineno), holding code strongly to prevent code-id reuse; preserve None without coercion.
minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.miss: Read f_lineno exactly once; cache the returned native value; use the same value in origin and source lookup.
minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.hit: Use the previously observed native value for the same immutable code object and bytecode offset.
preserve: Full stack/parent walk, matching filenames, outermost module selection and phase classification
All legacy whole assertions, product code, UI operations, input vectors and return/native evidence
Original failure evidence and fresh exact execution/observation after reviewed retry
minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.applicability_boundary: This harness does not set f_lineno, runner frames have no trace callback, and project local trace disables line/opcode events. This narrow source scope must stay explicit; do not export the cache as a generic debugger replacement.
minimal_proposed_external_instrumentatio.alternative_not_required: A one-time co_lines index could avoid even first misses, but requires a stronger exact f_lineno/None/tracing-equivalence proof and is not proposed as the minimum change.
